notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
Fixed some things that needed fixing.

Doll now will only freeze when in line of sight 
Doll will always animate due to being able to see it through glass
Doll is put further from player when it respawns
Demon will grow when outside making it a bigger threat
Made the settings not lag when opening
Made light switches hit boxes bigger
